name: comp-164
title: CPU Core Selector
description: CPU core selector as a 3-column grid of radio cards with disabled states. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup.
use: Configuring server or product tiers where different option combinations are valid or unavailable.
avoid: When there are many options or detailed descriptions are needed for each choice.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with proper labels, disabled state styling, and focus-visible indicators.
